class.name: RopeStiffnessParameters
class.brief_description: Resource for stiffness properties.[br]Stiffness forces the rope to return to its resting position. The resting direction is downwards and affected by the the node's rotation.

members.member: The strength at which the rope is forced into its resting position.

(Optional) Scales the stiffness according to how far a segment is bent.[br]The [code]y[/code] value of the curve is multiplied with the stiffness. [code]x = 0[/code] corresponds to no bending and [code]x = 1[/code] corresponds to 180° bending.
(Optional) Scales the stiffness along the rope.
